business_problem: Campari Group, a major player in the global spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium iconic brands such as Aperol, Campari, and SKYY, has always prioritized growth and agility. As the company grows, it aims to continuously improve internal processes and create efficiencies, particularly in how its employees—called Camparistas—collaborate across functions and geographies. Campari Group wanted to create a more streamlined, productive environment where employees could focus on strategic, creative work rather than spending time on manual, repetitive processes. This forward-thinking mindset led it to seek innovative solutions to support its global workforce and stay competitive in an ever-changing industry. “We’ve always been committed to agility and performance,” says Denajda Aliaj, Global IT Manager, Modern Workplace at Campari Group. “As we continue to grow, we are committed to continuously improve how we collaborate and make decisions.”
solution_summary: Campari Group used Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Viva to surface grounded answers from enterprise knowledge faster.
